<b>Craws</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are scavenging members of the [[Craws]], roosting high in caverns and preying on passing pilgrims.<ref>Craw Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Screeching scavenger that roosts high in caverns and preys on passing pilgrims."</i></ref> 

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Craws are often found sitting on various things, including things in the background or foreground. When they spot Hornet, they take flight and pursue her.<br>
They fly in short arcing flaps, and try to maintain distance between themselves and Hornet, performing a horizontal swooping attack at her once they have aligned themselves with her.

Craws deal {{Damage|1}} with their swoop and upon contact.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Craws have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin
| columns = 2|
* Shiny, shiny, all for us!
* Our nest! Our clan!
* Swoop and scratch...
* Crack their shells...
* Our caves! Our land!
* Take their treasures!
}}

== Location ==
Craws can be found exclusively in [[Greymoor]], and are much more common the further east Hornet is. They are especially plentiful near [[Greymoor#Sub-Area: Craw Lake|Craw Lake]].<br>
In [[Act 3]], Craws are replaced by [[Craw Juror]]s until [[Crawfather]] has been defeated. After his defeat, regular Craws appear again in their former locations.
